how:
- **Getting them.** Keys dropped by npcs open chests. Each chest offers three rewards, and each
  one is independently a modifier, a piece of gear or an xp reward, so one chest can offer three
  modifiers. Selecting a card explains it in the chatbox, and the menu's status line shows how
  many stacks you already hold. Only key chests give modifiers: supply crates never do.
- **Rarity and keys.** Every modifier is **common** (steady, smaller effects), **rare**
  (build-defining) or **special** (run-defining, often with a catch). The key decides the odds:

  | | Bloody key | Bloodier key |
  |---|---|---|
  | Drop chance (per kill) | 24% | 6% |
  | Option is a modifier / gear / xp | 35% / 15% / 50% | 45% / 30% / 25% |
  | Modifier is common / rare / special | 78% / 20% / 2% | 25% / 60% / 15% |
  | XP lamp (per danger level, times your xp rate) | 2,000 xp | 5,000 xp |
  | XP rate boost | +20x | +50x |

  Gear options are always gear you can wear now. Your starter style is 6 times as likely as each
  other style (75% vs 12.5%). Mid-tier gear (granite, obsidian, the moon sets, the barrows sets,
  Karil's, Morrigan's, armadyl, crystal, masori, Ahrim's, Zuriel's, elder chaos and virtus) comes
  as a **whole set**, best-in-slot gear one piece at a time. Ranged weapons come with 100 ammo.
  XP lamps offer your style's skills first.
- **Stacking.** Taking a modifier you already hold adds a stack. Unless stated otherwise, every
  number below is **per stack** and adds up linearly (two stacks of Recoil reflect 20%). Most
  specials can only be held once. Soaking and Speed demon go up to rank 3, each rank with its own
  number. Chests stop offering a modifier once you hold its maximum.
- **Per player, per run.** Modifiers belong to whoever picked them and end with the run.
- **Healing cap.** No healing from modifiers or food takes you above your hitpoints level. Only
  Saradomin brews and ambrosia boost past it.
- **Seeing them.** Your modifiers show on the buff bar above the chatbox, each with its own icon,
  its stack count (or rank) and a tooltip. Modifiers held once show no count. The bar fits 12
  icons (8 in fixed mode), spell buffs first. RuneLite's Timers & Buffs plugin shows some of them
  again under the wrong names, so turn it off.

categoryIntro.Offense:
Extra hits from Recoil, Cleave and Echo strike are *typeless*: they never trigger melee effects
(so Cleave splashes cannot cleave again) and are not boosted by damage bonuses. They land one game
tick later.
categoryIntro.Defence:
Modifiers that change damage you take are applied in this order when the hit lands:
[Soaking](#soaking) (teammates take their share), [Glass cannon](#glass-cannon),
[Shieldbearer](#shieldbearer), Thick skin, Evasion, then the death savers:
[Immortal](#immortal) first, then [Second wind](#second-wind).
categoryIntro.Prayer:
Protection prayers matter against bosses (TzTok-Jad's attacks are fully blocked by the right
one), so these help train Prayer alongside bones (buried, or offered on the boss altar) and
prayer potions. Xp is before xp rates, so it is multiplied by your xp rate like any other xp.
categoryIntro.Loot: These use the stacks of the player credited with the kill (the one who dealt the most damage).
categoryIntro.Special:
Special modifiers are rare finds (2% of bloody key modifier options, 15% of bloodier key ones)
that change how a run plays. Most come with a catch, and most can only be held once.

modifiers.name: Blood fury
modifiers.summary: 20% chance on melee hits to heal 30% of the damage dealt
modifiers.body:
The amulet of blood fury's effect, without wearing it.

- Each of your melee hits has a **20%** chance to heal you for **30%** of the damage it dealt
  (rounded down).
- Stacking raises the chance: 2 stacks is 40%, 5 stacks always procs. The heal amount does not
  stack.
- With [Draw your sword](#draw-your-sword), your ranged and magic hits count as melee hits too.

modifiers.name: Regeneration
modifiers.summary: Heal 1 hitpoint about every 10 seconds
modifiers.body:
- Heals **1** hitpoint about every **10 seconds** (every 16 game ticks, checked every 5 ticks).
- Stacking raises the amount healed each time, not the frequency.

modifiers.name: Soul harvest
modifiers.summary: Heal 1-2 hitpoints on every kill
modifiers.body:
- Every kill heals you for a random amount between **1** and **2** hitpoints. With several stacks,
  the range becomes `stacks` to `2 × stacks`.
- A kill is credited to whoever landed the hit that brought the npc to 0 hitpoints, including
  hits from Cleave, Echo strike and Recoil.

modifiers.name: Hearty appetite
modifiers.summary: Food heals 50% more
modifiers.body:
- Food heals **50%** more (rounded down). A shark heals 30 instead of 20 with one stack, and 40
  with two.
- Low rolls round away: a purple sweet that rolls 1 still heals 1 with a single stack.

modifiers.name: Second wind
modifiers.summary: Once, survive a lethal hit on 1 hitpoint and heal to 50%
modifiers.body:
- Once per stack, a hit that would kill you instead leaves you on **1** hitpoint and then heals
  you to **50%** of your hitpoints level.
- Each stack is a single use. Picking the modifier again later adds a fresh charge.
- It is checked last, after [Glass cannon](#glass-cannon), [Thick skin](#thick-skin) and
  [Evasion](#evasion) have changed the hit.

modifiers.name: Recoil
modifiers.summary: Reflect 10% of damage taken back at the attacker
modifiers.body:
The ring of recoil's effect, without wearing it.

- When an npc hits you, **10%** of the damage you actually took is reflected back at it (at least
  1, if you took any damage).

modifiers.name: Cleave
modifiers.summary: Melee hits splash 25% of their damage (rounded up) onto adjacent npcs
modifiers.body:
Built for the island's swarms. The whole server is multi-combat, so crowds gather quickly.

- Each melee hit splashes **25%** of its damage (rounded up) onto every other living npc within
  **1** tile of your target.
- Because it rounds up, every melee hit that deals damage splashes at least 1: a hit of 1 to 4
  splashes 1, a hit of 5 to 8 splashes 2.
- With [Draw your sword](#draw-your-sword), your ranged and magic hits cleave too.
- Splash damage gives combat xp like the hit it came from, in the skills your attack style
  trains (melee xp, or ranged or magic xp for cleaving ranged and magic hits).

modifiers.name: Echo strike
modifiers.summary: 10% chance for any hit to strike again for 50%
modifiers.body:
- Each hit (melee, ranged or magic) has a **10%** chance to strike again for **50%** of its
  damage (at least 1).
- Stacking raises the chance; 10 stacks echo every hit.
- The echo gives combat xp like the hit it repeats, in the skills your attack style trains.

modifiers.name: Long reach
modifiers.summary: +1 attack range per stack (up to 3), melee included
modifiers.body:
- **+1 attack range** per stack, for every style: melee (so a scimitar hits from 2 tiles away),
  ranged, magic, autocasting and spells cast on an npc directly.
- With [Draw your sword](#draw-your-sword), ranged and magic start from its 1 tile and Long reach
  adds to that.
- Range never goes past 10 tiles, the most any attack can reach.
- Stacks up to **3** times.

modifiers.name: Berserker
modifiers.summary: +20% damage while below 50% hitpoints
modifiers.body:
- Your hits deal **20%** more damage while you are below **50%** of your hitpoints level.
- Pairs naturally with [Blood pact](#blood-pact), which keeps draining your hitpoints.

modifiers.name: Executioner
modifiers.summary: +50% damage against npcs below 25% hitpoints
modifiers.body:
- Your hits deal **50%** more damage to npcs below **25%** of their hitpoints.

**How damage bonuses combine.** Berserker, Executioner and [Glass cannon](#glass-cannon) add
together before being applied. A hit of 10 with Glass cannon (+30%) and Berserker (+20%) becomes
15, not 15.6. Bonuses apply to your melee, ranged and magic hits on any npc, when the hit is
dealt.

modifiers.name: Thick skin
modifiers.summary: Every hit taken is reduced by 1
modifiers.body:
- Every hit you take is reduced by **1** (to a minimum of 0).
- It never saves you from a hit that would kill you: a lethal hit is not reduced. (Npc hits are
  capped to your hitpoints when they are queued, so otherwise you could not die once your hitpoints
  were at or below the reduction.)
- Very strong early, when npcs hit 1s and 2s, and fades as the director sends heavier hitters.

modifiers.name: Evasion
modifiers.summary: 10% chance (up to 50%) to avoid a hit completely
modifiers.body:
- Each hit you take has a **10%** chance to be avoided completely, up to a maximum of **50%**
  (5 stacks).
- An evaded hit shows as a blocked (blue) 0.

modifiers.name: Devout
modifiers.summary: Kills give Prayer xp (50% of the npc's level) and restore 1 prayer point
modifiers.body:
- Every kill (landing the killing blow) gives Prayer xp worth **50%** of the npc's level, worked
  out from its current stats like its loot level. A level 40 npc gives 20 xp, or 2,000 at 100x.
- Every kill also restores **1** prayer point, up to your Prayer level.

modifiers.name: Divine ward
modifiers.summary: Npc attacks your protection prayer is up against give Prayer xp (25% of their level)
modifiers.body:
- Every npc attack of a style your protection prayer is up against (melee, missiles or magic)
  gives Prayer xp worth **25%** of the attacker's level, whether it would have hit or not.
- Protection prayers block npc hits completely, so the xp comes from the attacker's level rather
  than the damage blocked.
- It needs a protection prayer (level 37+) to do anything, so it trains Prayer further rather than
  getting you there.

modifiers.name: Scavenger
modifiers.summary: +10% equipment drop chance, +15% chance of a higher tier
modifiers.body:
- Equipment drop chance rises by **10** percentage points (from a base of 45%).
- The chance of equipment rolling one tier higher rises by **15** percentage points (from a base
  of 5%). However high it gets, the 25% chance of a lower tier always remains.

modifiers.name: Treasure hunter
modifiers.summary: +50% key drop chance (max 2 stacks; keys capped at 2x)
modifiers.body:
- Both key drop chances (bloody 24%, bloodier 6%) rise by **50%** of their base chance: 36% and
  9% with one stack, 48% and 12% with two.
- It can be held at most **2** times.
- **Key cap:** however Treasure hunter and [Bounty](#bounty) combine, keys never drop more than
  **2x** as often as normal (48% bloody, 12% bloodier). Their bonuses add together, so two
  Treasure hunter stacks, or Bounty on the team, reach the cap. Chests stop offering Treasure
  hunter to a player at the cap.
- More keys means more chests, which means more modifiers.
- In a team, every member who damaged an npc rolls for its keys at their share of the damage, with
  their own Treasure hunter stacks (and the team's Bounty), and their keys drop only for them.

modifiers.name: Sweet tooth
modifiers.summary: Purple sweet drops multiplied by (1 + stacks)
modifiers.body:
- Purple sweet drops are multiplied by **(1 + stacks)**: 1-3 sweets become 2-6 with one stack.
  (Solid food is not affected.)

modifiers.name: Glass cannon
modifiers.summary: Deal and take 30% more damage
modifiers.body:
- Your hits deal **30%** more damage (added to the other damage bonuses).
- Hits you take deal **30%** more damage.

modifiers.name: Bounty
modifiers.summary: The director spawns faster, the whole team's drop chances double (one per team)
modifiers.body:
- The run's director earns **50%** more spawn credits, so one player's Bounty makes the island
  more dangerous for everyone.
- So it is **team-wide**: every member's drop chances (equipment, food, bones, gear upgrades and
  both keys) rise by **100%**.
- Only **one** member of a team can hold it. Chests stop offering it once anyone on the team has
  it.
- Keys are also held to the [key cap](#treasure-hunter) (2x their normal chance), which Bounty
  reaches on its own.

modifiers.name: Blood pact
modifiers.summary: Lose 1 life point a tick per stack, or heal at that rate from a pool of the damage you deal
modifiers.body:
- Every game tick, you lose **1** life point per stack. The drain never takes you below 1 life
  point.
- Every point of damage you deal goes into a pool, which holds at most your max life points. While
  the pool has any, the tick heals you instead: **1** life point per stack, taken from the pool.
  The pool is used up at the same rate even at full health, so it cannot be banked.
- So healing comes back over time, not with the hit: a hit of 40 at 1 stack is 40 ticks (24
  seconds) of healing.
- It waits while the run is paused (before it starts, and after a boss is defeated). Dying empties
  the pool.
- Stacks up to **5** times.
- Combine with [Berserker](#berserker) for a high-risk damage build.

modifiers.name: Maxed, but at what cost
modifiers.summary: Level 99 in every combat skill, but no more xp
modifiers.body:
- Instantly sets Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints, Ranged, Magic and Prayer to level **99**,
  fully restored.
- From then on, **you gain no xp** from any source for the rest of the run, so no skill can go
  past 99 (and chests stop offering xp lamps and xp rate boosts).
- Only offered from world **3**. Taken in world 1, it put a player far ahead of every boss for
  the rest of the run.
- Can only be held once.

modifiers.name: Draw your sword
modifiers.summary: Double ranged and magic damage, but only from 1 tile
modifiers.body:
- Your ranged and magic attacks deal **double damage** (added to the other damage bonuses).
- They can only be made from **1 tile** away, so ranged and magic players have to fight up close.
  This applies to autocasting and to casting spells on an npc directly. [Long reach](#long-reach)
  still adds its range on top.
- Your ranged and magic hits also count as melee hits for [Blood fury](#blood-fury) and
  [Cleave](#cleave).
- Can only be held once.

modifiers.name: Soaking
modifiers.summary: Take 20/30/50% (by rank) of teammates' damage for them
modifiers.body:
For group runs. Solo, it has no effect.

- Each hit a teammate takes is partly taken by you instead: **20%**, **30%** or **50%** of it at
  rank 1, 2 or 3, rounded up. A hit of 3 at rank 1 puts 1 on you and 2 on your teammate.
- The share is dealt to you as a separate hit a tick later, and your own defensive modifiers
  apply to it. Damage you soak is never passed on again.
- Several soakers each take their share, up to the whole hit.

modifiers.name: Shieldbearer
modifiers.summary: Take 50% less damage while wearing a shield
modifiers.body:
- You take **50%** less damage while wearing a shield (any off-hand item with "shield" in its
  name, such as kiteshields and square shields).
- Picking it gives you a **wooden shield**, so it works straight away.
- Applied after Glass cannon and before Thick skin.
- Can only be held once.

modifiers.name: Osmumten's champion
modifiers.summary: Every accuracy roll is made twice
modifiers.body:
Osmumten's fang's accuracy, on every weapon.

- Every accuracy roll you make (melee, ranged and magic) is made **twice**, and the attack lands if
  either roll succeeds.
- Osmumten's fang and the drygore blowpipe already roll their attack roll twice against one
  defence roll. With this modifier they roll it **3 times** instead.
- Can only be held once.

modifiers.name: Speed demon
modifiers.summary: Attacks are 20/30/50% (by rank) faster
modifiers.body:
- Your attacks are **20%**, **30%** or **50%** faster at rank 1, 2 or 3. Attack delays are
  rounded down: a 4-tick weapon attacks every 3, 2 or 2 ticks, and a 5-tick weapon every 4, 3 or
  2 ticks. Attacks are never faster than every tick.

modifiers.name: Immortal
modifiers.summary: A lethal hit fully heals you instead (5 minute cooldown)
modifiers.body:
- A hit that would kill you leaves you on 1 hitpoint, then **fully heals** you.
- It then recharges for **5 minutes**. While it is charged, it saves you before
  [Second wind](#second-wind), so Second wind's single-use charges are kept for when Immortal is
  recharging.
- Can only be held once.
